rationale: Genome-wide CRISPRi (hCRISPRi-v2, dCas9-KRAB) screen in PaTu8902 PDAC cells immunostained for surface MHC-I; the top and bottom 30% were sorted. The paper compares the MHC-I high and low bins; knockdown of MHC-I degraders (NFXL1, TEX264-NBR1 capture) raises surface MHC-I, so they are enriched in the high bin, while MHC-I pathway genes (B2M, TAP1, HLA-A) are enriched in the low bin. One library per bin and no unsorted sample, so BARCS uses the no-replicate path (overdispersion pooled over the 1895 non-targeting guides); calls are screening-level. prepare.R removes the four header lines and takes the gene from the sgId prefix (alternative-promoter guides pooled per gene). Library totals; the two bins have similar composition.
